mod archive {
    enum Message { Chunk { content: Vec<u8>, start: u32 } }
    impl Message {
        fn pack(&self) -> Result<Vec<u8>, &'static str> {
            let mut body = Vec::new();
            let kind = match self {
                Self::Chunk { start: pos, content: data } => {
                    append(&mut body, *pos);
                    body.extend(data);
                    19
                }
            };
            if body.len() > CAP {
                return Err("limit");
            }
            let mut result = Vec::with_capacity(body.len() + 5);
            result.push(kind);
            result.extend((body.len() as u32).to_be_bytes());
            result.extend(body);
            Ok(result)
        }
        fn unpack(input: &[u8]) -> Result<Self, &'static str> {
            if input.len() < 5 {
                return Err("short");
            }
            let length = u32::from_be_bytes(input[1..5].try_into().unwrap()) as usize;
            if length > CAP {
                return Err("limit");
            }
            if input.len() != length + 5 {
                return Err("length");
            }
            let payload = &input[5..];
            let output = match input[0] {
                19 => {
                    let (start, content) = payload.split_at_checked(4).ok_or("field")?;
                    let start = u32::from_be_bytes(start.try_into().unwrap());
                    let content = content.to_vec();
                    Self::Chunk { start, content }
                }
                _ => return Err("tag"),
            };
            Ok(output)
        }
    }
    fn append(out: &mut Vec<u8>, n: u32) {
        out.extend(n.to_be_bytes());
    }
    const CAP: usize = 2048;
}
